sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for a monochrome assistant app. Make ONE square PNG sprite atlas: EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 16 cells total, no external margins or gutters. Each row is ONE distinct icon in FOUR successive animation frames, left to right. Each cell is square, with its icon centered at the exact cell center. Cell centers are x/y 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, 87.5% of the canvas. Icons occupy 60% of their cell width and height, identical scale and baseline across each row. Uniform clean very thin black outline strokes, rounded caps and joins, simple geometric silhouettes, no hatching, no shading, no large filled shapes, no grey or colour. Transparent background with real alpha. No visible grid, labels, numbers, text, borders or shadows. Design to remain legible when each cell is displayed at 48px: simple recognizable details, approximately 1.5px stroke at that display size. Exactly four icons, each repeated four times with very subtle purposeful frame changes. First frame is a clear neutral resting pose. Final frame returns nearly to first for a quiet looping animation. Request 1024x1024. Theme: ANIMALS. Row 1: owl head, blinks gently across the four frames. Row 2: fox head, tiny ear twitch. Row 3: cat head, tiny ear twitch and blink. Row 4: small bird in side profile, gently lifts and lowers one wing. Keep all heads or silhouettes facing the same way across frames. Calm intelligent character, never cartoonishly cute.
